name: PalPanelServerMods
description: Server-only Community-Raid build with static authoritative arena and visible vanilla fire-marker ring. The visual backend uses BP_pal_b00_building_Lordenfel_Brazier_Lit_01_C, a vanilla AStaticMeshActor, and requires no client installation. Previous BuildObject and SkillEffect visual fallbacks remain disabled because they caused reproducible crashes.
